summary.zh-CN: 运行时峰值内存是一段执行过程中，某一时刻所有仍然存活的设备内存分配之和。它不仅包含模型权重，还可能同时包含输入输出、[[term:intermediate-activation|中间激活]]、[[term:operator-workspace|算子工作区]]、缓存、[[term:compiler|编译]]后权重副本和运行时缓冲。
summary.en-US: Runtime peak memory is the sum of all device-memory allocations that remain alive at one moment during execution. It includes not only model weights, but also inputs and outputs, [[term:intermediate-activation|intermediate activations]], [[term:operator-workspace|operator workspaces]], caches, [[term:compiler|compiler]]-generated weight copies, and runtime buffers.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 峰值是‘在同一时刻一起活着的内存’，不是模型文件大小，也不是把每层激活简单相加。
coreConclusion.en-US: Peak memory is the memory that is alive at the same time. It is not the model file size and not the simple sum of every layer's activations.
